edits.old: and rwb-comms writes only the dispatch entry (GAP-0578).
edits.new: and rwb-comms writes only the dispatch entry (GAP-0578). A repeat of a proof-of-delivery read writes no second entry: it adds 1 to the duplicate_count of the DP07 freshness stamp of the business date and writes nothing else (GAP-0580). The append is called as POST /api/recovery/source-data/v1/interactions with an Idempotency-Key and answers 201 with the entry ID and case_seq; a repeated key with the same body answers 200 with the first entry; a reused key with a different body answers 409; an invalid field answers 422 with MSG-GEN-001; a caller without Case record C answers 403; an unknown or out-of-scope case answers 404 with MSG-P4-003; a failed write answers 503 with MSG-P1-022; the caller is a saga step that treats any non-2xx as a failed action and never keeps an action without its entry (GAP-0375, GAP-0504). The case-side link table interaction_link in rwb_case holds one row per case action that names its ledger entry, with the states PENDING, COMMITTED and REFUSED; one idempotency key is derived per action reference and the append runs before the local commit; the Flyway version is assigned by the sequence owner (GAP-2255). The path is /interactions on the service base /api/recovery/source-data/v1, the login is the rwb_source_data login, the property names are those of the API Specification and the required flags are settled at the baseline review (GAP-0505). An EFS history entry is keyed EFS:<efs_record_key>; this service counts the view rows it folds into one entry, and the ledger writer counts the hits of a repeated append in its idempotency store (GAP-0590).
